report_comment.text: SRGAP3 encodes SLIT-ROBO Rho GTPase-activating protein 3. RAF1 encodes CRAF, a RAF-family serine/threonine kinase in the MAPK pathway. The fusion removes RAF1 amino-terminal inhibition while retaining its kinase domain and partner self-association regions. Experimental expression produced MAPK activation and tumors from p53-null mouse astrocytes; MAPK and PI3K/mTOR activation were both documented in NIH3T3 fibroblasts. Drug-response studies support investigation of RAF-dimer and downstream pathway inhibition. The BRAF-fusion tovorafenib indication does not automatically include RAF1 fusions.
